summary: Jefferies Financial Group Inc. filed a 424B5 pricing supplement on April 21, 2026, for the issuance of $1,478,000 aggregate principal amount of Senior Autocallable Barrier Notes due April 22, 2031. The notes are linked to the worst-performing of iShares MSCI Emerging Markets ETF and EURO STOXX 50 Index. Payments are unsecured and subject to the issuer's credit risk. There is no acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation; this is a routine structured notes offering. The filing represents an ordinary capital markets transaction with no impact on corporate control or strategy.
